code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if grid[r][c] == 0 and 0 < r < h - 1 and 0 < c < w - 1]
    if not cells:
        return []
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
    return [[grid[h - 1 - r][c] for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)]
            for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
'''
progdir=base/'programs'; progdir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(code)
